ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized distal tip clusters and linear surface disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-grey to black contiguous surface covering >90% of visible area. High-contrast white/off-white clusters are mapped to the far lateral tips of both lobes. Three distinct parallel white linear pixel strings are mapped to the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with acute angular convergence at the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the entire visible trailing edge of both lobes; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude is highest on the medial section of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curve along the trailing margins, sweeping upward and outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of circular/elliptical high-contrast white pixels located at the far lateral margins (tips) of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A set of three parallel, diagonally oriented white linear pixel disruptions located on the dorsal-facing surface of the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of distinct parallel rake marks on the right lobe and significant mineralized/biological growth at the lateral extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: The lower central fluke and peduncle insertion point are obscured by high-intensity white pixel noise (water spray/foam).
